description: Execute a patrol or audit pack — read-only posture checks that produce findings or compliance evidence. Classification: ADVISORY for low/moderate sensitivity, MANDATORY for high sensitivity. REJECTS remediation/hardening packs (use gia_apply_pack for those). Audit packs produce deterministic pass/fail per NIST control — no AI interpretation.

approved_by.description: Required ONLY for high-sensitivity packs. Human approver identity.

pack_id.description: Patrol or audit pack ID (e.g. patrol-open-ports-v1, audit-nist-ac-basics-v1)

scout_data.description: Pre-collected command outputs keyed by step number (e.g. {"step_1": "output..."}). If not provided, returns command definitions for caller to execute.

name: gia_run_patrol
